messages:
jamie: Heads-up — AcmeApp reporting a sudden spike in 5xx + intermittent auth failures against hosted inference in us-east starting ~02:15 UTC. Customer sees ~12% 5xx and repeated 401s, billing spike from retries. Escalating to incidents.

maya: On it. Which AZ/edge? Any quick request ids we can correlate? @alex can you pull p95 and gateway 5xx by az?

alex: Pulling logs now. Quick look: majority of errors tied to us-east-edge-2 and upstream transit to provider 'BlueWire'. I'm seeing packet reorder/retransmit spikes in our egress host meters around 02:10-02:25. Attaching a short mtr/traceroute summary I grabbed from an edge box:

alex: ```
traceroute to 203.0.113.5 (203.0.113.5), 30 hops max
 1 10.0.0.1 0.9 ms 0.7 ms 0.8 ms
 2 198.51.100.1 1.2 ms 1.1 ms 1.3 ms
 3 * * *
 4 203.0.113.5 45.7 ms 44.9 ms 120.1 ms

mtr --report --report-cycles 20 203.0.113.5
Packets: 20,  Loss%  Last  Avg  Best  Wrst StDev
 2. provider-hop  65.0%  120.1  108.4  44.9  240.6  38.3

Note the high loss/reorder at provider-hop.```

lina: We have correlated telemetry from backbone: increased retransmits and out-of-order on the WAN circuit used by us-east-edge-2. Provider acknowledged microbursts/jitter and applied a quick shaping tweak at 02:28 UTC.

jamie: Customer repro steps they shared: they run repeated single-shot requests and see 502/gateway timeouts plus occasional 401s despite valid tokens. Example from their logs: 

jamie: ```
REQUEST: POST /v1/generate
Status: 502
Body: {"error":"gateway timeout"}
Headers: x-rid: rA1b2c3, x-server: hosted-api-us-east-2

Then a followup attempt returns 401:
Status: 401
Body: {"error":"invalid_token"}
```

customer-rep (AcmeApp): Confirming — our telemetry shows the same pattern. When a request gets a transient connection reset we try to refresh token in client and sometimes re-issue the call which doubles request volume -> billing spike. This started exactly around 02:15.

maya: Hypothesis: packet jitter/reorder at provider causes TLS handshakes and long-tail reconnects to fail sporadically, producing 5xx and auth flakiness. Short-lived connection resets can cause our gateway to return 502s and client libraries to retry auth flows.

alex: Short-term mitigations we implemented: 1) increased gateway keepalive and reduced idle connection timeout to 10s to avoid premature closure, 2) enabled TCP fast-retransmit tuning on the edge boxes, 3) started a canary route shift to alternate transit for a subset of us-east traffic.

lina: Initiating canary route change now — shifting 10% of hosted-api us-east traffic to secondary-carrier path. Rolling in 10% -> 25% if stable.

net-bot: route-change-deployed: canary=10% id=rc-5790001111 user=lina

alex: Also capturing pcap slices and saving X-RID list for correlation. Example affected rids from customer: rA1b2c3, rD4e5f6, rG7h8i9. Will attach to incident ticket.

acct-billing: Noted the spike. I'll flag for potential credit if root cause is provider-side. Please have customer open a formal claim and attach the rids + timestamps.

maya: Early telemetry after canary: 5xx rate on canary path ~0.9% vs 12% on original path. Auth failures down to 0.7% in canary. Good signal. Lina, can you keep canary at 25% for 30m and continue monitoring?

lina: Affirmative. Increasing canary to 25% now. Provider says they'll escalate to on-call network ops for deeper fix (line conditioning / route optimization). I'll open a formal RFC with provider and request a BGP/port-level debug window.

jamie: Messaging to customer: "We routed a portion of traffic to an alternate transit which reduced errors; provider is investigating underlying circuit jitter. We'll follow up with timeline and next steps; billing team will review credits once provider confirmation is obtained."

customer-rep (AcmeApp): Seeing improvements on our side, thanks. Please send the curl repro we used so we can run deterministic tests:

jamie: Repro command shared: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' 
  https://api.redwood.hosted.us-east.example/v1/generate
```

alex: Follow-ups: saving pcaps to ticket, attaching traceroutes, gateway logs, and rids. Will produce a post-incident packet timeline.

maya: Action items: lina to coordinate provider debug window and RFC, alex to attach captures + logs + rid list, acct-billing to prepare credit workflow, jamie to update customer. Re-evaluate in 30m.

lina: Provider on-call confirmed physical link microbursts at timestamp window. They scheduled a maintenance window to re-term the circuit and add shaping at 04:00 UTC.

customer-rep (AcmeApp): Thanks — appreciate the quick routing work. We'll pause aggressive retries on client until you confirm stable.

jamie: Closing loop for now — continuing monitoring. :thumbsup:
